quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ
قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ
أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ
وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ
وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

parent_channels.name: P1: Joined Forms and Re-Fitted Creation

subchannels.name: The Joined and Adorned Canopy
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parts are joined into a raised covering, beautified, and inspected for gaps.
subchannels.active_motifs: building by joining parts `quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`; the sky as what rises and covers `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; beautifying a formed object `quranic:root_000660:B002/m01`; a cleft or gap in a whole `quranic:root_001139:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The sky is not merely a large object overhead. It is a fitted canopy whose coherence depends on joined components, visible finish, and the absence of ruptures. Adornment and gaplessness therefore operate as evidence that fabrication has reached a stable whole.

subchannels.name: Creation as a Replaced Garment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A form is measured and made, an old covering is displaced, and a new garment supplies the image of renewed embodiment.
subchannels.active_motifs: measuring before cutting or forming `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; creation as fabrication `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; a worn garment `quranic:root_000434:B009/m01`; a new garment `quranic:root_000227:B004/m01`; clothing as a covering `quranic:root_001341:B001/m01`; confusion produced by mixing `quranic:root_001341:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The question of a new creation acquires a material process: measure, fabricate, cover, and replace. The same lexical field that names confusion also supplies clothing, so perplexity about re-creation is reframed as failure to recognize that a formed covering can be renewed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A whole becomes intelligible through the fitting, joining, and covering operations that give it form.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:6 presents the sky as built, adorned, and without fissures, while 50:15 frames renewed creation as the object of confusion.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The lexical movement from construction to tailoring makes renewed creation resemble the replacement of a worn covering, not the recovery of an unstructured mass.

parent_channels.name: P1: Delivered Water, Layered Yield, and Emergence

subchannels.name: Rain as Delivered Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is sent down as a supplied stock whose retention enables growth and whose end use is provision.
subchannels.active_motifs: descent from above `quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`; delivery or sending down `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; water as a material resource `quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`; supplying by water `quranic:root_001458:B003/m01`; retained water that supports growth `quranic:root_000109:B003/m01`; rainfall functioning as provision `quranic:root_000560:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Descent is also delivery. The water arrives as usable material, is held rather than lost, and is converted into provision. Blessing is thus materialized as the capacity of a supplied resource to remain productive after arrival.

subchannels.name: Seed, Garden, and Harvest
subchannels.scene_or_process: Planting and emergence turn seed into screened, vigorous vegetation and finally into a cut yield.
subchannels.active_motifs: plants emerging `quranic:root_001465:B001/m01`; planting `quranic:root_001465:B002/m01`; a tree-screened garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; entwined vigorous vegetation `quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`; seed or grain `quranic:root_000286:B001/m01`; harvesting `quranic:root_000327:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is a complete agricultural conversion: seed is placed, growth comes outward, vegetation thickens into an enclosing garden, and the crop reaches harvest. The visible yield records several hidden operations that preceded it.

subchannels.name: The Palm as a Vertical Layered Assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: A palm rises to full height while its fruit-bearing growth emerges and stacks in ordered layers.
subchannels.active_motifs: the palm tree `quranic:root_001483:B001/m01`; height and complete growth `quranic:root_000117:B001/m01`; emergence of a spathe or plant growth `quranic:root_000945:B005/m01`; orderly stacking `quranic:root_001515:B001/m01`; natural layers `quranic:root_001515:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The palm concentrates growth into an architectural sequence: rise, emergence, and layered loading. Its fruit is not an undifferentiated abundance but an ordered assembly borne by a completed vertical form.

subchannels.name: Dead Ground Re-Enters the Cycle
subchannels.scene_or_process: A land deprived of life receives water, becomes living, and sends what was hidden outward in a recurrent return.
subchannels.active_motifs: death or loss of life `quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`; dead or unworked land `quranic:root_001454:B003/m01`; earth living through rain and plants `quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`; outward passage or emergence `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; recurrent return associated with rain and water `quranic:root_000544:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The land passes from interrupted productivity back into active output. Its revival is a recurrent mechanism in which water restores a latent capacity and the concealed product crosses outward, giving emergence a concrete ecological grammar.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What descends as a delivered resource is stored and transformed into successive visible forms of life.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:9-11 runs from blessed water through gardens, grain, palms, provision, revived land, and emergence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Resurrection is pressured by a production chain rather than a loose nature comparison: delivery becomes germination, ordered layering, harvest, and outward passage.

parent_channels.name: P1: Material Loss and Informational Retention

subchannels.name: Earth as a Decomposing Medium
subchannels.scene_or_process: The dead body becomes soil while the earth consumes, decays, and subtracts from its material form.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss or subtraction `quranic:root_001542:B001/m01`; an earth-creature eating material `quranic:root_000025:B010/m01`; a decaying or suppurating lesion `quranic:root_000025:B011/m01`; dust or soil `quranic:root_000178:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The earth is an active decomposing medium, not just the body's destination. Consumption, lesion-like decay, and subtraction describe several modes by which a prior form becomes materially unavailable.

subchannels.name: The Preserved Determining Record
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge of the lost form is fixed in writing, guarded, and retained as if in memory.
subchannels.active_motifs: disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; written text `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; a fixed decree `quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`; guarding or preserving `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`; retention in memory `quranic:root_000342:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The record answers material subtraction with another kind of persistence. Writing fixes what decay disperses, while guarding and memory prevent informational loss; restoration can therefore proceed from preserved determination rather than surviving matter.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Physical matter can diminish while its determining knowledge remains preserved.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:3-4 juxtaposes dust and what the earth subtracts with divine knowledge and a preserving book.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Earthly decomposition and written or remembered conservation divide the person into a lossy material trace and a lossless determining record.

parent_channels.name: P1: Covered Truth and Tangled Judgment

subchannels.name: Truth Covered and Called False
subchannels.scene_or_process: A real disclosure arrives, is covered from view, and is actively recast as false.
subchannels.active_motifs: covering something `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; concealing or rejecting truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; truth or reality `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; establishing or showing truth `quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`; accusing or denying as a lie `quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Rejection is a two-stage operation: the real is first covered and then redescribed as unreal. The lie is therefore not an independent object but a verbal cover laid over an arriving disclosure.

subchannels.name: The Entangled Affair
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mixed components lose a stable arrangement and become a tangled, wavering whole.
subchannels.active_motifs: a mixed or disordered affair `quranic:root_001411:B004/m01`; instability `quranic:root_001411:B005/m01`; an entangled branch or crooked arrow `quranic:root_001411:B006/m01`; confusion produced by mixing `quranic:root_001341:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Confusion is given shape as an object whose parts no longer align: branches interlace, an arrow loses its straight course, and mixed fabric obscures its construction. Cognitive instability is thus rendered as defective arrangement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Rejection works by covering what is real and then inhabiting the disorder produced by that concealment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:2 and 50:5 name rejection, denial of truth, and a tangled affair, while 50:15 names confusion about new creation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The rejecting mind resembles both a covered object and a garment whose materials have been mixed until its form is hard to distinguish.

parent_channels.name: P1: Collective Bonds and a Message Coming Due

subchannels.name: Peoples, Companions, and Tethered Kin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Groups cohere through peoplehood, companionship, and kinship, with the Rass adding a fixed or excavated place to collective identity.
subchannels.active_motifs: a human group or people `quranic:root_001273:B001/m01`; companionship `quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`; brotherhood or kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`; a tether or binding bond `quranic:root_000020:B002/m01`; being fixed in place `quranic:root_000562:B001/m01`; digging or placing in a pit or grave `quranic:root_000562:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The named collectives are not interchangeable labels. Companionship, tethered kinship, and attachment to a fixed or excavated place provide different mechanisms of group cohesion, all of which can carry a common stance across members.

subchannels.name: Dispatch, Denial, and Fulfilled Warning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Messages are successively dispatched to groups, collectively rejected, and converted by that response into a warning that is now due.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispatch or sending `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`; a messenger or message carrier `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; successive groups `quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`; accusing or denying as a lie `quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`; becoming due or obligatory `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; a threat or warning `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 50:12 `كَذَّبَتْ`; 50:14 `كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ`
subchannels.synthesis: Dispatch creates a social obligation to answer. Because rejection recurs across successive groups, the warning does not remain a remote possibility; the communities' repeated response is the operation by which it comes due.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Communities are held together by affiliations, but their common response to a dispatched message gives those bonds a shared outcome.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:12-14 names peoples, companions, brethren, messengers, collective denial, and the warning that became due.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The people of the Rass add a downward fixing or pit image to the social field, while successive dispatched groups turn repeated denial into an accumulating obligation.

parent_channels.name: P2: Interior Speech Rendered as Evidence

subchannels.name: Whisper Inside the Bound Body
subchannels.scene_or_process: Faint self-talk arises within intention and is known at a nearness figured by binding cords and the life vein.
subchannels.active_motifs: hidden self-talk `quranic:root_001651:B001/m01`; a faint sound `quranic:root_001651:B002/m01`; mind or intention within the self `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; nearness `quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`; a binding rope `quranic:root_000291:B001/m01`; bodily cords or veins `quranic:root_000291:B004/m01`; the life vein or jugular `quranic:root_001640:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Interior speech is faint but not placeless. It occupies the intending self within a body imagined through cords and a life-bearing vein; divine nearness reaches the signal before it has become public sound.

subchannels.name: Paired Receivers at Their Posts
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two receivers take in material while seated in opposed watch positions and maintaining guard.
subchannels.active_motifs: receiving or meeting what arrives `quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`; taking or learning speech `quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`; sitting in watch `quranic:root_001244:B005/m01`; watchful waiting `quranic:root_000584:B001/m01`; guarding `quranic:root_000584:B002/m01`; the right side `quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`; the left side `quranic:root_000819:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reception is spatially organized. Opposed posts create complete lateral coverage, while sitting, waiting, and guarding turn the reception of speech into a continuous office rather than an occasional intervention.

subchannels.name: Utterance Ejected into Readiness
subchannels.scene_or_process: An utterance crosses the mouth as an expelled object and immediately encounters prepared custody.
subchannels.active_motifs: spoken utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; ejecting something from the mouth `quranic:root_001364:B001/m01`; verbalizing `quranic:root_001364:B002/m01`; being present and prepared `quranic:root_000978:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Speech becomes evidentiary at the moment it leaves the mouth. Lexically, verbalization is expulsion; what exits the speaker as an object meets a witness already present and ready to receive it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech moves from inaccessible interior motion to received, guarded, and presentation-ready evidence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:16-18 proceeds from self-whispering and bodily nearness to paired receivers and every utterance being met by a prepared watcher.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The person is pictured as both a bound interior through which faint signals move and a source that ejects verbal objects into an already staffed reception system.

parent_channels.name: P2: Constriction, Signal, and Compelled Procession

subchannels.name: Death as Intoxication and Choking Narrowness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Death arrives as a truth that overwhelms sobriety, tightens passage, and defeats attempted deviation.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrival `quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`; intoxication or loss of sobriety `quranic:root_000725:B001/m01`; choking constriction `quranic:root_000725:B005/m01`; loss of life `quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`; truth or reality `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; deviation or avoidance `quranic:root_000376:B001/m01`; an angled protrusion that turns aside `quranic:root_000376:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Death constrains both perception and movement. Intoxication removes lucid control, choking narrows the available passage, and deviation becomes only an angled attempt to turn away from an arriving reality.

subchannels.name: Breath Converted into an Appointed Signal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Breath is sent into a horn, producing the signal that makes the threatened day operational.
subchannels.active_motifs: sending wind or breath into something `quranic:root_001529:B001/m01`; a horn `quranic:root_000891:B004/m01`; a catastrophic day `quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`; a threat or warning `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The warning passes from speech into mechanism. A directed breath activates an instrument, and its sound converts an announced day into a present event.

subchannels.name: The Self Driven Under Witness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Each living self arrives under directional force, accompanied by an escort who drives and another who bears testimony.
subchannels.active_motifs: the living self `quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`; driving or herding `quranic:root_000762:B001/m01`; following in one track `quranic:root_000762:B012/m01`; a present witness `quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`; testimony `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; arrival `quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The self is no longer an autonomous traveler. Driving supplies route and force, while testimony supplies an accompanying account; movement and evidence converge in one escorted arrival.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Agency narrows through a sequence in which death constricts, a signal initiates the appointed event, and each self is escorted into testimony.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:19-21 moves from death's intoxication through the horn blast to the arrival of every self with driver and witness.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Breath, which ordinarily sustains life, is redirected into a horn whose signal begins the procession of selves no longer controlling their route.

parent_channels.name: P2: Veil Removal and Edge-Sharp Sight

subchannels.name: Heedlessness as Unmarked, Covered Terrain
subchannels.scene_or_process: A subject moves without vigilant marks under a cover that blocks knowledgeable perception.
subchannels.active_motifs: heedlessness outside vigilance `quranic:root_001097:B001/m01`; being left unmarked or unwritten `quranic:root_001097:B002/m01`; unmarked land or path `quranic:root_001097:B006/m01`; a cover `quranic:root_001095:B001/m01`; a veil of ignorance `quranic:root_001095:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Heedlessness is not mere inattention. It is a condition in which the route bears no orienting marks and a covering prevents recognition, combining navigational and cognitive deprivation.

subchannels.name: Uncovering Produces a Cutting Gaze
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cover is removed, what was hidden is exposed, and vision takes on the penetrative quality of sharpened iron.
subchannels.active_motifs: removing a cover `quranic:root_001302:B001/m01`; exposing a hidden flaw `quranic:root_001302:B002/m01`; eyesight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; inner insight `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; hard iron `quranic:root_000002:B004/m01`; a cutting or penetrating edge, including sharp sight `quranic:root_000002:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Uncovering does more than restore ordinary visibility. The exposed field is met by a gaze hardened into an edge, joining physical acuity and inward recognition as one capacity to penetrate what the veil had concealed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Disclosure removes a cognitive covering and transforms sight from passive capacity into penetrating discrimination.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; all active anchors occur in 50:22, where heedlessness is a covering that is removed and sight becomes iron-sharp.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Heedlessness resembles both unmarked terrain and an ignorance veil, while awakened sight acquires the cutting function of a metal edge.

parent_channels.name: P2: Adjudicating Withholding, Rivalry, and Responsibility

subchannels.name: The Withholding Transgressor
subchannels.scene_or_process: Stubborn rejection becomes a barrier that withholds beneficial good, crosses bounds, and sustains suspicion.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealing or rejecting truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; stubborn deviation or resistance `quranic:root_001052:B001/m01`; withholding a gift `quranic:root_001448:B001/m01`; a barrier `quranic:root_001448:B002/m01`; beneficial good `quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`; transgression or overstepping `quranic:root_000993:B001/m01`; doubt or suspicion `quranic:root_000616:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The charges form one obstructive posture. Rejection resists incoming truth, withholding blocks outgoing good, transgression crosses the proper boundary, and suspicion supplies the mental state that maintains the barrier.

subchannels.name: A Rival Installed, Then the Accused Cast
subchannels.scene_or_process: Another object of worship is assigned beside God, after which the responsible subject is thrown away into severe punishment.
subchannels.active_motifs: assigning or making into a state `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`; an object of worship `quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`; another or a rival `quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`; throwing or casting `quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`; a discarded object `quranic:root_001372:B006/m01`; severe force `quranic:root_000782:B002/m01`; punishment `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 50:26 `جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ`, `أَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene reverses the accused's act. The person first assigns a rival to an illegitimate place and is then assigned the condition of a discarded object, cast under a force that cannot be resisted.

subchannels.name: The Bound Companion Disputes Causation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A companion joined to the accused contests causal responsibility, denying that it drove the other beyond bounds and locating the error in remote straying.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding things together `quranic:root_001221:B001/m01`; a companion `quranic:root_001221:B002/m01`; negotiation or disputed speech `quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`; causing or exceeding a limit `quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`; straying `quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`; disappearing or burial `quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`; distance `quranic:root_000131:B001/m01`; a litigant's dispute `quranic:root_000416:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Companionship supplies proximity but not transferable agency. The bound associate argues that causal overreach was absent and that the accused's path was already remotely astray; judgment therefore becomes a dispute over who moved whom across the limit.

subchannels.name: Prior Warning and Unalterable Verdict
subchannels.scene_or_process: A warning has already been advanced, the judicial word remains fixed, and neither substitution nor deprivation of servants' rights is admitted.
subchannels.active_motifs: advancing or preceding `quranic:root_001207:B004/m01`; intending or approaching `quranic:root_001207:B010/m01`; a threat or warning `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`; an appointed time or place `quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`; spoken judgment `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; substitution `quranic:root_000095:B001/m01`; altering a form `quranic:root_000095:B002/m01`; putting a thing in the wrong place or time `quranic:root_000967:B004/m01`; withholding rights `quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`; a servant `quranic:root_000973:B001/m01`; worshipful obedience `quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 50:28 `قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ`; 50:29 `مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ`, `بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ`
subchannels.synthesis: Finality rests on sequence and placement. Warning preceded verdict, so the judgment is neither surprise nor retroactive substitution; its immutability is paired with the claim that no servant's due is displaced or withheld.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Judgment separates distinct operations of culpability and fixes their consequences without allowing responsibility to be transferred.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:24-29 presents the accused profile, rival deity, companion's defense, prior warning, fixed speech, and denial of injustice.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The root of reception in 50:17 becomes throwing in 50:24 and 50:26: a system that first receives speech later casts the responsible party into judgment.

parent_channels.name: P3: Capacity, Appetite, and Surplus

subchannels.name: The Filled Vessel That Still Requests More
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vessel reaches fullness, speaks through its condition, and converts increase into an unsatisfied request.
subchannels.active_motifs: vessel fullness or capacity `quranic:root_001441:B001/m01`; increase or growth `quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`; requesting or bidding for more `quranic:root_000657:B004/m01`; a thing speaking by its state `quranic:root_001272:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Fullness fails to terminate appetite. The vessel's condition itself becomes speech, and increase is grammatically recast as a request, exposing a capacity whose defining trait is not size but inability to conclude consumption.

subchannels.name: The Near Garden and Gift Beyond Desire
subchannels.scene_or_process: A protected garden is brought near, receives the inhabitants' willing desire, and adds journey-like provision beyond what was requested.
subchannels.active_motifs: a tree-screened garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; approach or drawing near `quranic:root_000639:B001/m01`; nearness or rank `quranic:root_000639:B002/m01`; will or desire `quranic:root_000831:B002/m01`; increase or growth `quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`; provisions for a journey `quranic:root_000657:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Here increase is not demanded by an empty appetite. The destination approaches its guests, desire is fulfilled inside it, and the additional gift resembles provision supplied for an onward abundance even after arrival.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Receptacles disclose their disposition through what they do with fullness and increase.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:30 gives Hell a voice that asks for more after being filled, while 50:31 and 50:35 bring the garden near and promise whatever is willed plus increase.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hell speaks as a container whose state demands further input, whereas the garden's increase behaves as provision offered beyond desire rather than appetite seeking completion.

parent_channels.name: P3: Return into Guarded Permanence

subchannels.name: The Guarded Inward Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person repeatedly turns back, maintains vigilance before the unseen, and arrives with a heart oriented toward return.
subchannels.active_motifs: return to a home or refuge `quranic:root_000065:B001/m01`; guarding `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`; maintaining something `quranic:root_000342:B003/m01`; vigilance `quranic:root_000342:B004/m01`; reverent fear `quranic:root_000413:B001/m01`; what is hidden from sight `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`; the heart `quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`; turning a thing `quranic:root_001248:B004/m01`; a destination `quranic:root_001248:B005/m01`; recurrent return `quranic:root_001562:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Return is sustained rather than episodic. Guarding preserves the orientation, fear operates without visual possession, and the heart repeatedly turns toward its destination until inward movement becomes a stable disposition.

subchannels.name: Entry into Safe Permanence
subchannels.scene_or_process: The returning subject crosses inward into a protected chamber of peace and remains there without expiry.
subchannels.active_motifs: entering `quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`; an inner chamber or secret interior `quranic:root_000464:B003/m01`; safety or freedom from harm `quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`; peace `quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`; permanence `quranic:root_000429:B001/m01`; clinging or staying `quranic:root_000429:B002/m01`; a settled inward thought `quranic:root_000429:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Entry completes the motion of return by placing the subject inside rather than merely near the destination. Peace supplies protected occupancy, and permanence turns repeated orientation into settled presence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Repeated inward return is maintained until it resolves into secure, lasting habitation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:32-34 moves from the returning guardian and an inwardly returning heart to entry in peace on the day of permanence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The heart is both an inward organ and a turning mechanism; its recurrent orientation becomes the preparatory motion for entering a dwelling where turning no longer means instability.

parent_channels.name: P3: Penetration, Resistance, and Effortless Assembly

subchannels.name: Exhaustive Probing Without Escape
subchannels.scene_or_process: Strong generations range through lands, pierce routes in search of an outlet, exhaust their effort, and find no escape.
subchannels.active_motifs: destruction `quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`; exhausting effort `quranic:root_001596:B009/m01`; a generation `quranic:root_001221:B005/m01`; severe force `quranic:root_000782:B002/m01`; a violent grasp `quranic:root_000126:B001/m01`; roaming or searching lands `quranic:root_001539:B006/m01`; land or place `quranic:root_000148:B001/m01`; evasion or escape `quranic:root_000378:B001/m01`; no-exit confusion `quranic:root_000378:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Superior grasp does not produce an exit. The generations spend their force piercing and searching the land, but range only converts strength into exhaustion; the sought route folds back into a condition of no escape.

subchannels.name: Cosmic Fabrication Without Fatigue
subchannels.scene_or_process: Heaven, earth, and their interval are measured and fabricated as a connected whole without fatigue touching the maker.
subchannels.active_motifs: measuring before forming `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; creation as fabrication `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; the sky as what rises and covers `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; earth as the lower field `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; an interval between things `quranic:root_000170:B002/m01`; connection across an interval `quranic:root_000170:B003/m01`; touching or affecting `quranic:root_001423:B004/m01`; fatigue `quranic:root_001360:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 50:38 `خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا`, `مَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: The cosmos is one fabricated span, extending from lower field to raised cover and including the relation between them. Its scale does not register as depletion: fatigue cannot even make contact with the act that establishes the connected whole.

subchannels.name: Split Earth and Light, Rapid Gathering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Earth ruptures open under strain, yet the gathered bodies move out swiftly and with compliant ease.
subchannels.active_motifs: splitting or opening `quranic:root_000807:B001/m01`; a strenuous burden `quranic:root_000807:B003/m01`; speed `quranic:root_000698:B001/m01`; leading the first arrivals `quranic:root_000698:B002/m01`; driving or gathering a group to a destination `quranic:root_000324:B001/m01`; fine, sharp, or light movement `quranic:root_000324:B006/m01`; ease `quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`; light compliant movement `quranic:root_001694:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The rupture belongs to the earth, not to a difficult evacuation. Once the enclosure splits, the gathered group moves as a light, rapidly led body; a burdensome opening yields an easy collective passage.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Passage through resistant space exposes the difference between limited human force and divine operations that incur no fatigue.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:36 shows powerful generations probing the lands without escape, 50:38 denies fatigue in cosmic creation, and 50:44 depicts rapid, easy gathering through split earth.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Human probing resembles exhausting movement through a wasteland, while the final opening of earth is itself a strenuous rupture yet produces light, compliant motion for those gathered.

parent_channels.name: P3: Praise at Moving Boundaries

subchannels.name: Praise Along the Solar Passage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Patient praise accompanies the rising and withdrawal of the sun, moving with the two visible boundaries of daylight.
subchannels.active_motifs: restraining oneself in patience `quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`; worshipful praise `quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`; swimming or running motion `quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`; praise `quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`; sunrise or a rising luminary `quranic:root_000945:B001/m01`; the sun or daylight `quranic:root_000818:B001/m01`; sunset or the west `quranic:root_001077:B006/m01`; distance or withdrawal `quranic:root_001077:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Patience holds the worshipper steady while praise tracks a moving luminary. Rising and withdrawal define not isolated instants but a passage through which devotion continues, with the swimming image giving praise its own sustained motion.

subchannels.name: Night and the Traces After Prostration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Praise continues into nocturnal action and resumes behind or after the bodily act of prostration.
subchannels.active_motifs: night `quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`; action performed at night `quranic:root_001392:B002/m01`; what comes behind or after `quranic:root_000458:B002/m01`; considering an outcome `quranic:root_000458:B006/m01`; prostration or submission `quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`; a place of prostration `quranic:root_000675:B002/m01`; a bodily trace or member `quranic:root_000675:B003/m01`; worshipful praise `quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Worship extends on both temporal and bodily axes. Night changes the setting, prostration changes posture, and what follows the posture preserves its effect as praise continues in the traces left by submission.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Devotion is maintained through transitions of light, darkness, and bodily posture.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:39-40 places praise before sunrise and sunset, during the night, and after prostration.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Praise shares a root image with swimming or rapid motion, so repeated worship can accompany the sun's moving boundaries rather than merely mark static clock points.

parent_channels.name: P3: From Offered Hearing to the Unavoidable Call

subchannels.name: The Heart Offers Its Hearing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A remembering heart actively casts its faculty of hearing forward while remaining present enough to understand and bear witness.
subchannels.active_motifs: re-presenting what was forgotten `quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`; a reminder `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`; the heart `quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`; casting or offering `quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`; hearing `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; understanding or obeying what is heard `quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`; presence as a witness `quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`; testimony `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reception is an act, not a vacant condition. The heart projects hearing toward the reminder, comprehension turns sound into response, and presence makes the event witnessable within the listener.

subchannels.name: The Nearby Caller and Outward-Producing Cry
subchannels.scene_or_process: A caller raises sound from a near station; the cry becomes an inevitable disclosure that brings what was hidden outward.
subchannels.active_motifs: a raised call `quranic:root_001486:B002/m01`; an appearance resembling a call `quranic:root_001486:B008/m01`; nearness `quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`; a place or station `quranic:root_001332:B002/m01`; a high voice `quranic:root_000895:B001/m01`; a terrifying cry `quranic:root_000895:B002/m01`; truth or reality `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; becoming due or inevitable `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; outward passage `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; bringing the hidden out `quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 50:41 `يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ`; 50:42 `يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ`, `يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ`
subchannels.synthesis: The call joins location, sound, and result. Nearness removes acoustic distance, the raised voice becomes a terrifying cry, and its truth is measured by what it accomplishes: hidden bodies cross outward into emergence.

subchannels.name: Reminder Without Compulsion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recitation gathers words into a reminder that awakens fear of warning without forcing the hearer.
subchannels.active_motifs: coercion or compulsion `quranic:root_000216:B003/m01`; gathering into a collected text `quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`; reading or reciting `quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`; a reminder `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`; fear `quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`; awakening fear `quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`; a threat or warning `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Recitation forms a collected verbal address, but its efficacy is not mechanical domination. It re-presents the warning so that fear awakens in a receptive hearer, preserving a distinction between compelling attention and coercing assent.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Hearing ranges from a deliberately offered receptive posture to an acoustic disclosure that compels emergence, while reminder itself remains noncoercive.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 50:37 describes casting one's hearing while present, 50:41-42 commands listening for the nearby caller and true cry, and 50:45 limits the reminder to those who fear the warning.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Attention is something the hearer casts forward, but the final cry reverses initiative by drawing the hidden outward; the Quranic reminder stands between these poles as forceful address without compulsion.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1: Gathered Recitation and Re-Presented Reminder
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Words are gathered into recitation, carried as warning, and used to bring obscured knowledge back before the listener.
parent_channels.active_motifs: gathering into a collected text `quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`; reading or reciting `quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`; re-presenting what was forgotten `quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`; a reminder `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`; a warning that awakens caution `quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Recitation first gathers dispersed words into an ordered verbal object. As warning and reminder, that object does not merely transmit new information; it makes a neglected reality present again so that caution can awaken.

parent_channels.name: S2. Whole-surah: Well, Bucket, and Poured Water
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Rainwater is retained in a rock hollow or well, raised in a handled bucket on a standing apparatus, balanced under load, and poured into a receiving basin.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a rock hollow or newly dug well that retains rainwater `quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`; an elongated bucket with one loop `quranic:root_000737:B011/m01`; a bucket loop, side, or wooden support that balances its load `quranic:root_000741:B008/m01`; a large complete bucket or water carrier `quranic:root_001077:B002/m01`; water spilling from well buckets and filling a basin `quranic:root_001077:B003/m01`; a standing part of the well pulley apparatus `quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The cluster turns water provision into a complete handling mechanism: descent is caught, stored, lifted, balanced, and poured. This materializes the surah's rain-to-revival reading by showing how a delivered resource remains available for use, and it gives reception a tool-like precision rather than treating abundance as an unstructured flood.

parent_channels.name: S3. Whole-surah: Gestation, Birth, and Postpartum Passage
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hidden womb gathers a fetus, nourishment begins to prepare before delivery, birth sends the child and blood outward, and the womb passes through afterbirth and postpartum pain.
parent_channels.active_motifs: the concealed reproductive organ or womb `quranic:root_000383:B011/m01`; a womb gathering a fetus or blood `quranic:root_001210:B004/m01`; milk or colostrum descending before birth `quranic:root_000117:B003/m01`; childbirth, the newborn, and postpartum blood `quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`; the womb and discharge following the child `quranic:root_000994:B009/m01`; postpartum uterine pain or retained afterbirth `quranic:root_000552:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: New life is assembled in concealment before it crosses outward, with nourishment prepared in advance and bodily residue following emergence. This materially reframes the surah's disputed new creation: emergence is not an isolated leap from absence but the visible outcome of hidden collection, formation, provisioning, and release.

parent_channels.name: S4. Whole-surah: Lots, Overseer, and Divided Camel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Gambling arrows are gathered in a leather holder, administered by an overseer, drawn as ranked lots, and used to assign winning and losing portions of a slaughtered camel.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a leather holder gathering the arrows of the lot game `quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`; the game's overseer and third arrow `quranic:root_000584:B006/m01`; the fifth gambling arrow `quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`; the losing lot and what gambling takes away `quranic:root_000458:B019/m01`; players slaughtering a camel and dividing its parts by arrows `quranic:root_001694:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The practice assigns material shares through a concealed draw whose ranked arrows produce winners and losers. It usefully pressures the surah's judgment scenes by contrast: the preserved record, prior warning, and unalterable word do not allocate outcomes by chance, nor can responsibility be exchanged like a portion produced by the lots.

parent_channels.name: S5. Whole-surah: Burial as Deliberate Concealment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A realized death is followed by turning the body onto its right side, wrapping or hiding it, placing it in a grave, and leaving it in a settled resting place.
parent_channels.active_motifs: one realized state or instance of death `quranic:root_001454:B008/m01`; laying the dead on the right side `quranic:root_001698:B007/m01`; concealing the dead in a shroud or grave `quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`; hiding someone by burial in a grave `quranic:root_001117:B009/m01`; the grave as a settled resting place `quranic:root_000897:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Burial appears as an intentional sequence of orientation, covering, placement, and settlement rather than mere disappearance into earth. This materializes the interval between death and gathering, so the earth's later splitting reverses a deliberate human act of concealment and sharpens the surah's claim that hidden bodies remain recoverable.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole-surah: Arrow Balance and Missing the Target
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An arrow is fitted to the string, its feathers determine its balance and lightness, and defects or excess trajectory carry it beyond and behind the intended target.
parent_channels.active_motifs: an arrow's nock and its placement on the bowstring `quranic:root_001188:B009/m01`; fine arrow feathers or a light arrow `quranic:root_000324:B006/m02`; weak or misaligned arrow feathers `quranic:root_001360:B002/m01`; an arrow rising beyond its target `quranic:root_000945:B010/m01`; an arrow passing or falling behind the target `quranic:root_000458:B018/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Direction depends on fitted components: an arrow can be light and balanced, weakened by bad feathers, or driven past its mark. The scene usefully pressures the surah's directional claims by contrast, since death, the cry, warning, and judgment reach their appointed subjects without the deviation, defect, or overshoot that can spoil a human shot.

parent_channels.name: S7. P1-P2-P3 Role Progression: Contested Truth Becomes Effective Event
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 to P2 to P3. Bridge: a repeated truth-bearing scene signature changes the role of truth from disputed content, to an encountered condition, to a causally effective signal.
parent_channels.active_motifs: truth matching reality `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; truth becoming due or binding `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; denying something as a lie `quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`; arrival `quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`; a terrifying cry `quranic:root_000895:B002/m01`; bringing what is hidden outward `quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: P1, 50:5 `كَذَّبُوا بِٱلْحَقِّ`; P2, 50:19 `جَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ`; P3, 50:42 `يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ`
parent_channels.synthesis: In P1, truth can still be treated as an object of speech and called false. In P2, the same truth-marker qualifies death's arrival, so truth is no longer merely argued about but encountered as a condition. In P3, it qualifies a cry whose result is outward emergence. The bridge is this increase in causal force: denial cannot keep truth at the level of contested discourse because the surah progressively gives it event, sound, and material outcome.

parent_channels.name: S8. P1-P3 Reversal: Earth Changes from Subtractor to Releaser
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 to P3. Bridge: the same material setting undergoes a role reversal, first diminishing what is placed within it and later opening to release a gathered population.
parent_channels.active_motifs: earth as the lower material field `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; loss or subtraction `quranic:root_001542:B001/m01`; splitting or opening `quranic:root_000807:B001/m01`; outward passage `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; gathering a group to a destination `quranic:root_000324:B001/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: P1, 50:4 `تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ`; P3, 50:42 `يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ`; P3, 50:44 `تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ`
parent_channels.synthesis: P1 assigns earth an inward operation: it receives bodies and subtracts from their available matter. P3 reverses that operation without changing the medium: earth splits from around them, outward passage replaces diminution, and separated occupants become a gathered body. The bridge materializes resurrection as a change in the earth's function, from enclosing and reducing to opening and delivering.

parent_channels.name: S9. P1-P2-P3 Causal Bridge: Warning Moves from Notice to Event to Reminder
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 to P2 to P3. Bridge: warning follows a causal role progression from dispatched notice, to appointed event and prior judicial notice, then returns as present address that can awaken caution.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a messenger or carried message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; a threat or warning `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`; an appointed time or place `quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`; breath sent into an instrument `quranic:root_001529:B001/m01`; a horn `quranic:root_000891:B004/m01`; advancing or preceding `quranic:root_001207:B004/m01`; a reminder that restores presence `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`; awakening fear that prompts caution `quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: P1, 50:14 `كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ`; P2, 50:20 `نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ`; P2, 50:28 `قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ`; P3, 50:45 `فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ`
parent_channels.synthesis: P1 locates warning in the messenger-recipient relation and shows it becoming due through rejection. P2 gives that warning an appointed day, activates it through the horn, and treats its earlier delivery as prior notice in judgment. P3 turns the depicted future back toward the present hearer through reminder and caution. The bridge makes judgment neither accidental nor unannounced: notice precedes event, remains evidentially available, and is renewed before the hearer's response is fixed.

parent_channels.name: S10. Whole-surah: Official Register, Inkwell, and Identifying Mark
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An identifying mark makes its bearer distinguishable, writing clarifies the intended identity, an inkwell supplies the pen, and a name is entered into an official register.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a distinguishing mark or guiding sign `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; disclosure of meaning through writing, speech, or sign `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; entering a name in an official register or roll `quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`; an inkwell supplying a pen with ink `quranic:root_001407:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The preserved record acquires a concrete production sequence: identity is marked, meaning is made legible, ink sustains inscription, and the name is assigned a stable place in the roll. This supports the surah's answer to material loss by showing how a record can preserve not merely undifferentiated data but a recoverable, individually identified subject.

parent_channels.name: S11. Whole-surah: Written Surety and Personal Guarantee
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A guarantor remains attached to the guaranteed party, a written undertaking names the assumed obligation, and a recognized community representative stands as witness and surety.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bearing a guarantee and remaining with the guaranteed party `quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`; guaranteeing another person through an undertaking or written bond `quranic:root_001198:B008/m01`; standing surety over a person `quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`; a community representative who serves as witness or guarantor `quranic:root_001539:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Surety is a formal social mechanism, not mere companionship: obligation is expressly assumed, fixed in writing, and backed by a recognized representative. This usefully pressures the companion's defense in the judgment scene. Proximity alone does not create a valid transfer of liability, and the accused cannot acquire a guarantor after responsibility has already been fixed.

parent_channels.name: S12. Whole-surah: Appraisal, Advance, and Bargained Price
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Goods reach a market, their value is appraised, a contract is bound, an advance is paid, and the buyer seeks a reduction in the agreed price.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a marketplace where goods are brought for sale `quranic:root_000762:B005/m01`; valuation, appraisal, and pricing of goods `quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`; binding and strengthening a contract `quranic:root_000782:B001/m01`; an advance or prepaid price in a sale `quranic:root_000737:B005/m01`; a buyer asking that the price be reduced `quranic:root_001542:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The transaction allows value to be assessed, terms secured, payment advanced, and price contested. It therefore sharpens the surah's judicial contrast: the final word is not a market quotation, the assigned outcome is not open to bargaining, and no late request can discount or substitute what the record has made due.

parent_channels.name: S13. Whole-surah: Hidden Hunter, Heart Strike, and Verification
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hunter goes out, watches unseen from a blind, strikes the quarry at the heart, and then inspects it to determine whether death has occurred.
parent_channels.active_motifs: going out in pursuit of game `quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`; a screen behind which a hunter or archer hides `quranic:root_000584:B011/m01`; striking or being struck in the heart `quranic:root_001248:B016/m01`; inspecting wounded game to verify whether it has died `quranic:root_001454:B014/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The quarry's inability to see the concealed watcher does not interrupt observation, impact, or verification. This role structure usefully pressures the surah's heedlessness and surveillance scenes: being unaware of the watcher is not being unwatched, and death is an observed outcome rather than an uncertainty that permits escape.

parent_channels.name: S14. Whole-surah: Main Vessel, Tender, and Anchor
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A chief sailor directs a pitched vessel, a small tender remains available for its needs, and an anchor arrests the movement of the larger craft.
parent_channels.active_motifs: the chief of a ship's sailors `quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`; a pitched or tar-coated ship `quranic:root_000973:B005/m01`; a small tender accompanying a larger vessel `quranic:root_001212:B011/m01`; a ship's mooring and anchor `quranic:root_000564:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The maritime assembly distinguishes propulsion and support from the operation that ends drift. Captain and tender sustain navigation, but the anchor changes a moving vessel into a fixed one. This materializes the surah's mountains as stabilizers: their firmness is not inert mass alone but an anchoring function that holds an extended earth in place.

parent_channels.name: S15. Whole-surah: Night Watering, Satiety, and Return
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A herd travels toward water, reaches the watering place, drinks while water is drawn at its mouths, fills to satiety, gives a thirsty animal another turn, and moves to nearby pasture before returning.
parent_channels.active_motifs: night travel or urgent movement toward a watering place `quranic:root_001212:B008/m01`; arrival at water or the route to a watering place `quranic:root_001640:B001/m01`; drawing water at the mouths of drinking camels `quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`; drinking or filling a waterskin to satiety `quranic:root_000286:B006/m01`; returning a thirsty camel to the trough for another drink `quranic:root_000464:B007/m01`; moving from water to nearby pasture and then returning `quranic:root_001486:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Water provision becomes a regulated cycle of approach, arrival, filling, accommodation, grazing, and return. This supports the surah's rain and recurrence readings by showing provision sustaining movement beyond the first drink. It also contrasts with Hell's unending request for more: embodied creatures can reach satiety and re-enter a life cycle, while the consuming vessel cannot complete its intake.

parent_channels.name: S16. Whole-surah: Spark, Bellows, and Growing Flame
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Fire-bearing wood is struck, weak sparks appear, bellows direct air into the ignition, and the fire develops into an intense flame.
parent_channels.active_motifs: weak sparks that give little usable fire `quranic:root_000286:B011/m01`; wood suited to striking and producing abundant fire `quranic:root_001398:B005/m01`; blowing air into a fire with bellows `quranic:root_001529:B001/m02`; a bright, intense, or smokeless flame `quranic:root_001411:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Combustion advances through material and directed input: suitable wood yields sparks, air feeds them, and flame intensifies. This materially reframes Hell's request for more as the operating appetite of fire, while the bellows sense of directed breath resonates with the horn blast as another moment when an otherwise latent process is activated by air.
